quote: Rejecting AIPAC money isn't enough — every member of Congress must be clear on these issues.

summary: Khanna introduced an amendment to strike Section 224 of the NDAA (US-Israel military integration); it failed in a House Armed Services Committee voice vote. He argued the provision 'rewards Benjamin Netanyahu.'
quote: An amendment to sink the pro-Israel measure, introduced by Democratic Congressman Ro Khanna, failed in a voice vote on Thursday in the House Armed Services Committee.

summary: Khanna co-sponsored a measure with Thomas Massie to block U.S. funding for Israel's military and criticized the House Rules Committee for preventing a floor vote.
quote: It is unconscionable to not even have a vote," she wrote on X/Twitter. "We will be continuing on and will not be intimidated by the pro-Israel lobby."

summary: Khanna opposed NDAA Section 219's proposed U.S.-Israel military integration and called for removing it to protect U.S. sovereignty.
quote: I am opposing Section 219, that would integrate our military with Israel’s. The United States does not have this arrangement with any other country in the world. We need to stand up for American sovereignty and strip this provision from the final NDAA. https://t.co/wmVG27nT4i

summary: Khanna opposed $2.8 billion in bombs for Israel and urged spending that money on Americans' food and gas costs instead.
